title: Redesign Analyzer Criteria
description: Evaluation schema for the Analyzer Agent. Each field is scored during the Input Layer ingestion phase. Businesses with visualScore < 4 are flagged as primary redesign targets.

businessName.description: Legal or trade name of the business.

url.description: Root URL of the website being evaluated.

visualScore.description: Subjective or AI-assigned visual design quality score. Scores below 4 trigger redesign targeting.

hasMobileResponsiveness.description: True if the site passes a mobile-responsiveness check (viewport meta, fluid layout, no horizontal overflow).

ctaCount.description: Number of distinct call-to-action elements detected on the homepage.

loadTimeSpeed.description: Time-to-first-byte or fully-loaded time in milliseconds.

trustSignals.description: Trust indicators found on the site.

notes.description: Optional analyst notes or agent observations.
